title: Infernux v0.4.3-v7 · Hotfix 7: Dependency Updates and Restart Control
codename: Hotfix 7: Dependency Updates and Restart Control
summary: This hotfix prepares Python dependency replacements before editor startup, keeping loaded libraries intact until the editor closes. The base engine version remains 0.4.3; wheels use build 7, with Hub 0.4.3-8.

items.title: Ask to restart only when an installation would replace a library already loaded by the editor, including transitive dependencies. Unloaded libraries install without a restart prompt.
items.text: Ask to restart only when an installation would replace a library already loaded by the editor, including transitive dependencies. Unloaded libraries install without a restart prompt.

items.title: Keep the current environment and plugin registration intact when choosing Later. Restart Now uses the existing save/discard/cancel workflow; cancelling keeps the editor open and the installation pending.
items.text: Keep the current environment and plugin registration intact when choosing Later. Restart Now uses the existing save/discard/cancel workflow; cancelling keeps the editor open and the installation pending.

items.title: Resume the prepared installation after the old editor exits, then launch a fresh interpreter so new site hooks and package paths take effect normally.
items.text: Resume the prepared installation after the old editor exits, then launch a fresh interpreter so new site hooks and package paths take effect normally.

items.title: Restore missing project and plugin requirements during launch preparation, preserving locked versions and keeping dependency installation out of the running editor's startup checks.
items.text: Restore missing project and plugin requirements during launch preparation, preserving locked versions and keeping dependency installation out of the running editor's startup checks.

items.title: Respect direct-URL source changes and the requirements of other dependency owners when restoring a plugin's previous libraries during uninstall.
items.text: Respect direct-URL source changes and the requirements of other dependency owners when restoring a plugin's previous libraries during uninstall.

items.title: Group the plugin package list under category headers when All is selected, retaining search, sorting within each category, selection and details.
items.text: Group the plugin package list under category headers when All is selected, retaining search, sorting within each category, selection and details.

items.title: Complete project-lock handoff before allowing the editor process to prepare dependencies or start its replacement. Stop and Retry also terminate the replacement editor and installation subprocesses.
items.text: Complete project-lock handoff before allowing the editor process to prepare dependencies or start its replacement. Stop and Retry also terminate the replacement editor and installation subprocesses.

items.title: Preserve the short Windows Python host and the project's private Python home during restart, including projects with long or non-ASCII paths.
items.text: Preserve the short Windows Python host and the project's private Python home during restart, including projects with long or non-ASCII paths.

items.title: Open projects using earlier installed SDKs through their own startup entry; enable dependency preparation only when the installed SDK provides it.
items.text: Open projects using earlier installed SDKs through their own startup entry; enable dependency preparation only when the installed SDK provides it.

items.title: Respect the automatic-update preference when opening the engine installation page; manual update checks remain available.
items.text: Respect the automatic-update preference when opening the engine installation page; manual update checks remain available.

items.title: Require matching published Windows and Linux Player release identities before SDK publication. Rebuild the companion desktop platform packages for this exact hotfix.
items.text: Require matching published Windows and Linux Player release identities before SDK publication. Rebuild the companion desktop platform packages for this exact hotfix.
